skillsbench-docker-grading.name: skillsbench-docker-grading
key_points: The `solution/` directory is not executed — it contains reference/oracle scripts. You must produce outputs yourself.
skillsbench-docker-grading.description: SkillsBench grading protocol: host evaluator stages files to temp dir, runs pytest or test.sh. Deliverables must exist at task-root paths staged by the evaluator.
